item.title: Supreme Court strikes down bulk of Trump's tariffs
item.description: The Supreme Court cast aside the bulk of President Trump's sweeping tariffs Friday, obliterating a canon of his economic strategy in ruling that his use of an emergency statute to remake global trade was unlawful. item.title: Double homicide investigation underway after shooting in LaPlace
item.description: Deputies with the St. John the Baptist Parish Sheriff's Office are investigating a double homicide in LaPlace on Thursday, Feb. 19.

item.title: Fifth Circuit Court rules public schools in Louisiana can display Ten Commandments
item.description: The U.S. Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals ruled that public schools in Louisiana can immediately start posting displays of the Ten Commandments on Friday, Feb. 20, vacating a preliminary injunction that had blocked the law.

item.title: Six arrested, accused of running Terrebonne Parish drug operation
item.description: The Terrebonne Parish Sheriff's Office arrested six people who are accused of running a drug operation, according to Sheriff Tim Soignet.

item.title: NOPD investigates traffic fatality on Chef Menteur Highway
item.description: Officers with the New Orleans Police Department are investigating a fatal traffic accident that happened on the morning of Saturday, Feb. 21.
